The '''W202 holdout blaster''' was a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]] produced by [[MandalTech/Legends|MandalTech]]. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Mirta Gev]] used one sometime in [[45 ABY]] while under contract with [[Marvid Qreph|Marvid]] and [[Craitheus Qreph]]. Gev was tasked to guard their [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who later managed to escape and steal Gev's hold-out blaster from her.<ref name="Crucible (novel)">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref>
